jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Evervault

Evervault offers modular payments infrastructure for companies building their own payments stack. We keep raw card data off your systems, cut PCI compliance work, improve acceptance, mitigate fraud and chargebacks and decrease your cost of payments, so you keep full control. Trusted by Ramp, Rippling, Modern Treasury and Overwolf; Series B, led by Ribbit Capital.

Role Overview

Traditional BDR tactics are broken. We need someone who can engage CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Product and Engineering, and founders at 100–5,000 person companies at their moments of real need, through strategic timing and thoughtful outreach rather than generic cold emails. You'll report to our VP of Revenue and hand qualified opportunities to our Account Executives. Success looks like 16 qualified opportunities per quarter.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Tracking the signals that create a need for card infrastructure: adding a second PSP, expanding into new geographies, launching card issuing or embedded payments, or facing a PCI DSS audit

  • Mapping a target account's payment stack (processors, vault, checkout, 3DS provider) to pinpoint where they're feeling pain

  • Running outreach by call, email, LinkedIn and warm intros, tied to outcomes buyers care about: less PCI burden, routing freely across processors, higher auth rates, lower fraud

  • Running consistent cold-call blocks into target accounts

  • Turning fintech and founder/CTO events and communities into pipeline

  • Working with VCs, PSPs and partners to source warm introductions

  • Qualifying opportunities and handing them to AEs with clear context on the prospect's stack, pain and why now

Requirements

  • 1–2 years of BDR or SDR experience, ideally selling an API-based product to technical buyers

  • A track record of research-heavy, personalised outreach over high-volume activity

  • Comfortable cold calling technical executives

  • Real curiosity about connecting a business's payments problems to technical solutions

Nice to Have

  • Experience in payments, fintech or developer tools

  • Working knowledge of tokenisation, network tokens, 3DS or PCI DSS (we'll teach you the rest)

  • An existing network in the NYC fintech or startup community

This Might Not Be for You If…

  • You prefer high-volume sequences: we want fewer, better-researched conversations

  • You'd rather avoid the phone: cold calling technical buyers is a core part of the job

  • You don't want to learn the technical side: you'll need to hold credible first conversations about card payments with CTOs

Compensation, Benefits & Why Join

  • $60,000–$85,000 base salary, with on-target earnings of $105,000–$125,000

  • Stock options with an extended exercise window

  • Private health insurance

  • Generous vacation and flexible working hours

  • Catered lunch in our New York office

  • A clear path to Account Executive on a revenue team that's growing fast

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter screen

  2. Interview with our VP of Revenue

  3. Take-home case study

  4. Case study debrief

  5. Final interview with our founder

  6. References and Offer

Location

This role is based in New York (Soho), in our office Tuesday to Thursday. Applicants must be currently authorised to work in the US; we do not sponsor work visas.

Candidates must be based in the location specified. Any applications from candidates not in the required location may not receive a response.

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Evervault

Evervault offers modular payments infrastructure for companies building their own payments stack. We keep raw card data off your systems, cut PCI compliance work, improve acceptance, mitigate fraud and chargebacks and decrease your cost of payments, so you keep full control. Trusted by Ramp, Rippling, Modern Treasury and Overwolf; Series B, led by Ribbit Capital.

Role Overview

We're hiring our first dedicated Security Engineer. You'll join our platform group and own application security from day one, with scope to take on security across Evervault over time. Expect roughly half your first year on hands-on security engineering and half on audits, questionnaires and customer security reviews. Both are core to the job.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Finding and fixing vulnerabilities in our applications and infrastructure

  • Building security checks and tooling into how we develop and ship software

  • Working with engineers on security decisions in product and system design

  • Owning security and compliance audits, including evidence collection and resolving findings

  • Handling customer security reviews and questionnaires, and explaining our controls clearly

  • Setting how the security function works, through the code you ship and the practices you help the team adopt

Requirements

  • Strong engineering skills: comfortable writing production code, investigating unfamiliar systems and taking a fix through to completion

  • Deep, practical security expertise across application and infrastructure security

  • Hands-on experience with PCI DSS

  • Experience taking audits through to resolution

  • You use AI daily and actively look for ways it can improve your work

Nice to Have

  • Experience in card payments, particularly running or securing a cardholder data environment

  • Experience as a first or sole security engineer

  • A product company background before Series C

  • Rust, Node.js, AWS or Terraform (we care more about engineering ability than our exact stack)

This Might Not Be for You If…

  • You want pure offensive or research work: around half the role is audits, questionnaires and customer reviews

  • You want to manage people soon: this is an individual contributor role with no immediate management remit

  • You need a tightly defined brief: you'll be shaping the security function as you go

  • You want to work fully remotely: we're in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday

Compensation, Benefits & Why Join

  • Competitive London Salary

  • Stock options with an extended exercise window

  • Full, top-tier health insurance

  • Daily lunch budget

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Cyclescheme

  • Define the security function at a fast-growing payments infrastructure company, working closely with the engineers who build it

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter screen

  2. Hiring manager interview

  3. Technical interview #1

  4. Technical interview #2

  5. Final Founder interview

  6. References and offer

Location

This role is based in London, in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday. We do not currently sponsor UK work visas.

Candidates must be based in the location specified. Any applications from candidates not in the required location may not receive a response.

jobs.title: Product Engineer, Experience
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Evervault

Evervault offers modular payments infrastructure for companies building their own payments stack. We keep raw card data off your systems, cut PCI compliance work, improve acceptance, mitigate fraud and chargebacks and decrease your cost of payments, so you keep full control. Trusted by Ramp, Rippling, Modern Treasury and Overwolf; Series B, led by Ribbit Capital.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a full-stack Product Engineer to build the dashboard, APIs and SDKs developers use to run their payments on Evervault. You’ll own features end to end: talking to users, scoping the problem, building the backend services and the UI, then shipping and iterating. Much of the work sits behind data-heavy interfaces, so you’ll build APIs and charts that stay fast and accurate on large datasets. You’ll work in TypeScript across the stack, alongside engineers and product, and care about how the result looks and feels as much as how it works.

What you’ll do

  • Own features end to end. Talk to users, scope the problem, build the API and the UI, ship it, and iterate.

  • Build and extend the backend services and APIs behind our dashboard.

  • Build data-heavy interfaces: charts, tables and filters that stay fast and accurate on large datasets.

  • Shape the developer experience across our dashboard, APIs and SDKs.

  • Work with engineering and product on what we build and why.

Requirements

  • 5+ years building production software, with a strong recent focus on product engineering.

  • Expert TypeScript across the stack: React on the frontend and Node.js on the backend.

  • You have designed and shipped APIs and data models, and you know databases and query performance well.

  • You have built interfaces for large or complex datasets, and you know how to make charts that are correct and fast.

  • Good product taste. You start with the user problem, and you care about how the result looks and feels.

  • Work you can show us, such as a portfolio, GitHub, or features you can talk through in detail.

    Nice to have

  • Experience building analytics or observability products, such as PostHog, Datadog, Grafana or Amplitude.

  • Experience with event data and analytical databases, for example ClickHouse.

  • Experience building developer-facing products.

  • Experience at an early-stage or fast-growing startup.

  • Experience with a design system or component library.

This might not be for you if…

  • You want to focus purely on design or frontend: much of the work is backend APIs, data models and query performance

  • You’d rather work from a spec: you’ll talk to users and scope problems yourself

  • You don’t enjoy data-heavy work: charts, tables and filters on large datasets are core to the role

  • You want to work fully remotely: we’re in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday

Compensation, Benefits & Why Join

  • Competitive London Weighted salary

  • Stock options with an extended exercise window

  • Private health insurance

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Daily lunch budget

  • Shape how developers see and use Evervault, across both product and brand

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter screen

  2. Hiring manager screen

  3. Technical Stage

  4. Final round with our founder

  5. References and offer

Location

This role is based in London, in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday. We do not currently sponsor UK work visas.

Candidates must be based in the location specified. Any applications from candidates not in the required location may not receive a response.

jobs.title: Product Engineer, Cards
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Evervault

Evervault offers modular payments infrastructure for companies building their own payments stack. We keep raw card data off your systems, cut PCI compliance work, improve acceptance, mitigate fraud and chargebacks and decrease your cost of payments, so you keep full control. Trusted by Ramp, Rippling, Modern Treasury and Overwolf; Series B, led by Ribbit Capital.

Role Overview

We’re hiring a Senior/Staff Product Engineer for our Cards team in London. You’ll own problems end-to-end across our payments infrastructure: tokenisation, card network integrations, 3DS and dispute management. That runs from customer conversations, through API design, to production code and measuring whether it worked. You’ll lead by example: mentoring, raising the bar and owning technical direction, staying hands-on the whole time.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building core payments infrastructure, including tokenisation, network integrations, 3DS and dispute management

  • Designing developer-facing APIs, SDKs and primitives that developers enjoy using

  • Building high-throughput, distributed systems that handle millions of card transactions

  • Working directly with customers to understand their payment stacks, debug integrations and shape the roadmap

  • Shipping across the stack: backend services, APIs, UI components and documentation

  • Setting technical direction and mentoring engineers on the team

Requirements

  • 6+ years of engineering experience, including 2–4+ recent years in at least one of: payments infrastructure or fintech, developer tooling, or design-first products

  • Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, networking and infrastructure, beyond just frameworks

  • Product-minded: you think about the developer experience of every API you design and judge your work by its impact on users

  • Comfortable explaining complex technical decisions to non-technical people and working in front of customers

  • Founder-like ownership: you take problems to completion without waiting to be told what to do

Nice to Have

  • Rust and TypeScript experience (we care more about engineering ability than our exact stack)

  • Knowledge of card payments: networks, tokenisation, 3DS or PCI DSS

This Might Not Be for You If…

  • You want to build from a spec: you’ll be expected to find and define the problem yourself

  • You want to manage people soon: this is primarily a Senior IC role with technical leadership rather than people leadership

  • You prefer to stay in one layer of the stack: you’ll move between backend, APIs, UI and docs

  • You’d rather avoid customers: you’ll be on calls and debugging integrations with them

  • You want to work fully remotely: we’re in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday

Compensation, Benefits & Why Join

  • Competitive, London weighted salary

  • Stock options with an extended exercise window

  • Private health insurance

  • Unlimited PTO and flexible working hours

  • Daily lunch budget

  • Senior technical influence on a small, fast-growing team building infrastructure that processes millions of card transactions

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter screen

  2. Hiring manager screen

  3. Technical/Pair programming Interview

  4. Systems design (for Staff-level candidates)

  5. Final round with our founder

  6. References and offer

Location

This role is based in London, in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday. We do not currently sponsor UK work visas.

Candidates must be based in the location specified. Any applications from candidates not in the required location may not receive a response.

Evervault offers modular payments infrastructure for companies building their own payments stack. We keep raw card data off your systems, cut PCI compliance work, improve acceptance, mitigate fraud and chargebacks and decrease your cost of payments, so you keep full control. Trusted by Ramp, Rippling, Modern Treasury and Overwolf; Series B, led by Ribbit Capital.

Role Overview

You’ll be the first engineer dedicated to our data platform, and you’ll design and build it largely from scratch. You’ll own the platform that collects our event data, models it, and serves it to customers with roughly 15-second freshness, including building our time-series foundations. This is a senior, hands-on role: you’ll set the architecture, write most of the code and set the bar for the data team that grows around you. You’ll work closely with our VP of Engineering, Product and our leadership team. Product decides which data products to build; you own how they’re built and what the data can support.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Designing and building real-time ingestion for three sources: events our platform already emits, new instrumentation in our product, and data our customers send us

  • Rebuilding our event streaming layer, with the authority to choose how

  • Modelling structured and time-series data in ClickHouse and Databricks so aggregations, trends and benchmarks are fast and cheap at scale (our current defaults, though you can make the case for change)

  • Designing the external data contracts and APIs customers build on, including versioning, reliability and isolation of each customer’s data

  • Defining the event contracts our product engineers instrument against

  • Owning the platform in production: monitoring, data quality, cost and on-call for the systems you build

Your First Year

In your first few months you’ll assess what we have, decide the platform architecture, and scope our first data product with Product and Engineering. After that, you’ll rebuild the streaming layer and ship the first external product on the new platform, most likely aggregated analytics or direct data access for customers. Later in the year you’ll help us hire a domain expert who decides which signals and benchmarks are worth building. Machine learning is out of scope for now; it comes once we have enough clean historical data.

Requirements

  • Production experience building real-time or near-real-time ingestion with event streaming, such as Kafka, Kinesis or Redpanda

  • Deep experience with ClickHouse or a similar analytical database, including modelling time-series data for fast aggregation at volume

  • A track record of shipping an external, multi-tenant data product or data API that customers depended on (internal reporting pipelines alone won’t cover this)

  • Experience migrating a messy live system to a new one without downtime or data loss

  • Senior-level engineering habits: system design, testing, and running the services you build in production

  • Sound judgement working independently: you’ll be our most senior data voice, and we’ll rely on your technical calls

  • A product mindset: you won’t work directly with customers, but you’ll often be the person who knows what the data can and can’t support

Nice to Have

  • Experience in payments or with sensitive, regulated data

  • Databricks or Spark experience alongside ClickHouse

  • Experience as an early or founding member of a data team, including hiring

This Might Not Be for You If…

  • You’re mainly an analyst, BI or data science specialist: this role builds the platform and the external products on it

  • Your experience is mostly dashboards, internal reporting pipelines or modelling for analysis

  • You want a hands-off architect role: you’ll write most of the code

  • You want to work fully remotely: we’re in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday

Compensation, Benefits & Why Join

  • Competitive salary

  • Stock options with an extended exercise window

  • Private health insurance

  • Unlimited PTO & flexible working hours

  • Daily lunch budget

  • Build a company’s data platform from the first line of code, with the authority to make the big architectural calls and work directly with C-Level

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Hiring Manager Interview

  3. Technical Interview

  4. System Design Interview

  5. Final with our Founder

  6. References and Offer

Location

This role is based in London, in our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday. We do not currently sponsor UK work visas.

Candidates must be based in the location specified. Any applications from candidates not in the required location may not receive a response.
